intent: Four theme-consistent fantasy layered-mountain oil painting references; sunset/day update only. Independent flower PNGs are unchanged.

assets.prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather / stylized-concept. Edit target: attached V03 fantasy mountain BACKGROUND panorama. Produce one full-bleed ultra-wide panoramic background, approximately 3:1, same composition and framing, no flowers in foreground.
Primary change: change ONLY the time-of-day light and palette to a bright luminous SUNSET: pale peach, coral, apricot, cream and blush sky, golden sun low at far left; light pink mist and warm olive/sage mountains; softly warm cream cumulus clouds. No moon, no stars, no dark night blue.
KEEP the distinctive new V03 composition: multiple asymmetric layered ridges and fantasy rocky peaks climbing diagonally and rhythmically into the distance, luminous cumulus CLOUD SEA between ridges, flowing ribbons of pink woodland on the hills, broad rolling mist, rich aerial depth. Preserve this cascading fairyland mountain range; DO NOT return to a single central postcard Hallasan dome. Grounded landscape, not floating islands.
Art direction: semi-abstract OIL PAINTING with broad gestural paint masses, visible impasto and softly dragged palette-knife marks, loose generous patches of color, simplified tree masses and rock planes. Everything must feel painted rather than photographed. Avoid sharp leaf veins, tiny repetitive mosaic strokes, sharp CGI stone texture, photorealism and plastic 3D.
Brightness hierarchy: upper and middle scenery remain luminous, airy, light-filled and colorful; keep mountains readable rather than black silhouettes. Only bottom 15-20 percent is DARK charcoal-brown Jeju basalt-derived SOIL, an undulating horizontal planting foreground with low porous basalt rocks. Dark earth is textured but not pure black, no opaque rectangular strip. Preserve enough clear low ground for separate flowers later. Maintain warm-vs-cool oil color harmony, light mist separating ridges.
No foreground flowers, no flower hedge, people, buildings, animals, text, numbers, frame, watermark. One background image only; preserve the new mountain layout and change lighting/colors only.

Use case: compositing / stylized-concept. Create ONE finished integrated panoramic fantasy OIL PAINTING, approximately 3:1 ultra-wide, no border, text or watermark.
Image 1 is the NEW V03 fantasy-landscape EDIT TARGET. Keep its entire distinctive mountain composition: asymmetric ascending layers of rugged ridges, luminous great cumulus CLOUD SEA flowing between mountains, pink woodland ribbons on slopes, and mist. Preserve luminous peach/coral/apricot sunset with low golden sun at far left, warm olive ridges and pink mist. Do NOT replace it with a single postcard Hallasan mountain. Image 2 is ONLY a supporting reference for the foreground FLOWER DESIGN FAMILIES AND PALETTE; ignore its former landscape.
Integrate foreground flowers into image 1 as a beautiful coherent garden: coral-red and blush-pink camellias, loose apricot-orange marigolds, and fine ivory flower sprays; peach sunset rim light softly catching painted petal edges. Use irregular airy clumps with some hero blossoms in the foreground focus plane, smaller flowers receding into the view, spaces and height variation. All heads, stems and leaves must be healthy and visibly attached; planting contact with the dark Jeju basalt soil is natural. Preserve readable charcoal-brown volcanic earth and low porous basalt rocks along bottom and in gaps. No floating plants.
CRITICAL medium/style: semi-abstract, loosely gestural painted OIL; broad generous brush strokes, visible impasto and palette-knife color masses, simplified petal shapes and leaf silhouettes, expressive broken-color marks. Flowers are recognizable from their color and silhouette but NOT photorealistically detailed. NO tiny sharp leaf veins, no polished CGI, plastic 3D blooms, cutout-sticker collage, razor-sharp botanical engraving or mosaic micro-detail.
Focus hierarchy: the MAIN FLOWER HEADS are the sharpest PAINTED plane, with clear expressive petal marks; distant fantasy mountains/cloud sea are softer, airy and lower-contrast, recognizable broad paint masses. Add a few very near green grass blades, soft leaf shapes and low basalt at the bottom corners, visibly defocused by camera focus, framing rather than hiding flowers. At least 80 percent of main hero flower faces stay clear. Soft atmospheric light is enough: NO big glowing orbs or giant glitter balls.
Composition: flower garden occupies lower roughly 40 percent, with the layered fantasy landscape and clouds carrying the upper 60 percent. Avoid a flat uniform repeated flower hedge; make natural irregular groupings and depth. Keep whole image bright and beautiful, with darkest values confined to the low soil/rocks. Maintain the new V03 color harmony throughout, one unified painted scene.
